Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a large, dense opacity in the left upper lung zone with blunting of the costophrenic angle (indicating pleural effusion/hemothorax) in the context of trauma; this specific appearance is characteristic of a retained wooden foreign body, which can be radiopaque or appear as a focal density due to associated hemorrhage and edema, distinguishing it from typical contusions or pneumonia.
